edits.new: Compare the subjects represented by hierarchy nodes A and B. Decide whether the nodes represent equivalent subjects, whether one is a parent of the other, or neither.
edits.old: Compare hierarchy nodes A and B, whose subjects were extracted from social-media posts. Decide whether they express equivalent subjects, whether one is a parent of the other, or neither.

edits.new: Each node is supplied as a list of subject entries from one or more social-media posts. Each entry pairs a subject wording with a saved description of that subject in its source post. The source posts themselves are not being compared.
edits.old: Each node is represented by its subject wordings and saved context descriptions from the posts.
